messages.subject: Probit Regression. Lavaan.survey
parts:
Hi All,

I am running a probit regression model using the PISA data. Following, Lumley I am using lavaan.survey to account for the BRR weights and plausible values for achievement (I will be adding latent variables later, so svyglm is unfortunately not the answer in my case).

My model runs fine in lavaan but in lavaan survey, I get the following error when passing to lavaan.survey:

    Error in as.vector(w) * pw * x : non-numeric argument to binary operator

Any tips on ways around this would be great? 

Alternatively, given my exogenous variable in categorical, I wonder whether I should just be using a linear probability model instead (see Allison 1999; Mood 2010; Karlson, Holm and Breen 2012). If this is a viable option, how in lavaan should I account for hetroscedasicity? 

The setup is as follows:

TOTAL_M1 <- "
MATH ~ mA*middle + wA*working
Asp ~ B*MATH + mC*middle + wC*working
"

m3fit <- sem(TOTAL_M1, data = PISA_Aus$imputations[[1]], estimator = "WLSMV", ordered = c("LAA005"))
m3fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(m3fit, survey.design = clustPISA_Aus)

Regards,

Phil
